relations.OLD_DAY: a future weekday on which OLDHP1 has a swappable presence on the < 26 box and OLDHP2 can be a candidate

PLACEHOLDERS.PIDOPS_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's PolyID ops browser profile for the family's stage (outside results/)
PLACEHOLDERS.PORTAL_PROFILE: absolute path of the runner's PolyPortal ops browser profile (outside results/; HPN-26 flag read)

STAGE.doc: stage of the family's shared tenant: ct or preview

CRED_FILE.doc: absolute path of the runner's 0600 cred file for the family's shared-tenant users (outside results/), or 'none'

BEE_DECISION.doc: 'approved' only when the user decided the Beekeeper partner-token source (OQ-28) and the runner prepared the token-entry profile; else 'pending'

OLD_POMA_API.doc: poma-api URL of the < 26 box's stage when it is Preview (the harness has no Preview default), or 'none'
